map.多机型续航、速度、载荷、作业高度横向对比。: Side-by-side comparison of endurance, speed, payload and operating altitude of multiple models.
map.作业效率=幅宽×速度×时间 估算覆盖面积。: Operation efficiency = swath × speed × time to estimate the coverage area.
map.幅宽 B=5 m、速度 v=5 m/s、单架次 t=600 s：覆盖面积≈B·v: Swath B=5 m, speed v=5 m/s, single sortie t=600 s: coverage area≈B·v·t=5×5×600=15000 m²=1.5 hectares per sortie. When comparing two models, choose the more efficient one.
map.飞行高度 h=50 m、幅宽 5 m：地面分辨率与重叠率决定建模精度，高度越低分: Flight altitude h=50 m, swath 5 m: ground resolution and overlap determine the modelling accuracy; a lower altitude gives higher resolution but lower efficiency.
map.覆盖面积为何用幅宽×速度？: Why use swath × speed for the coverage area?
map.aerial 作业近似带状覆盖，单位时间面积=幅宽×地速，再乘架次时间得总覆盖。: Aerial operation approximates strip coverage: the area per unit time = swath × ground speed, multiplied by the sortie time to give the total coverage.
map.对比要注意什么？: What should be noted in the comparison?
map.续航受风温影响、载荷与续航权衡，选型需结合任务（测绘/植保/巡检）与当地法规限高: Endurance is affected by wind and temperature, and payload trades off against endurance; selection must consider the mission (surveying / plant protection / inspection) and local altitude regulations.
